# MP0023

Non-generic outcome tests do not match generic engine results; use Status, ExceptionOrDefault, or SkipDecisionOrDefault.

| Property | Value |
|----------|-------|
| Category | Usage |
| Default severity | Warning |
| Availability | Public analyzer package |

## Configure severity

```ini title=".editorconfig"
dotnet_diagnostic.MP0023.severity = warning
```

Use `none` to disable the rule, or `silent`, `suggestion`, `warning`, or `error` to change its severity.

## Suppress a specific occurrence

```csharp
#pragma warning disable MP0023
// Code that intentionally violates MP0023.
#pragma warning restore MP0023
```
